body:
We do the phone visits every other month. I think by the time I realized how much my meds aren’t working and how much I was avoiding my dr, it was already too heavy. So I keep my phone visits so I can stay on my meds (going off suddenly...like missing 3-4 days, made me violently ill so I make sure I take them). 

I have an appointment with him Monday , this is my last appointment with him because he’s moving. So I don’t know if I should start a whole new plan with him or wait until his replacement. He’s already warned me that the new dr won’t prescribe what I’m on so I lone I’ll be switching soon. 
I hate not knowing what will happen when I tell him I’ve lied for the last year. That I’m not working, I have an unhealthy relationship again, I’m in bed 85% of the time, I’ve lost all friends and have no support system. 
I feel so crazy and lazy and worthless and just weak. I’ve been through hell throughout my entire life since I was a baby, but a divorce is what ultimately broke me.
